Avant d’entrer dans la méthode, il faut: Before entering the method, you must speak the same language as the staff. Flip each card to check the definition, then move on to the test.
Ce qui est reconnu comme certain, incont: What is recognised as certain and indisputable (objective in nature).
Raisonnement partant de l’observation d’: Reasoning that starts from the observation of a fact.
Conséquence ou jugement déduit d’une déd: Consequence or judgement drawn from a deduction (subjective in nature). Takes the form of tasks, constraints, imperatives, requests, intelligence requirements or amendments to the timeline.
Les modes d’action amis (MA) sont compar: Friendly courses of action (MA) are compared with one another against criteria (weighted or not) set or approved by the commander, in order to draw their relative advantages and disadvantages.
Opposer chaque MA à chaque mode d’action: Pit each MA against each enemy course of action (ME), by successive phases or time steps, checking that each MA can cope with all the MEs considered; deduce risks, opportunities and adjustments from this. The MEs are the reference: they are not amended to fit the MAs; it is the MAs that are amended if necessary.
Prescription ou donnée objective imposée: Imposed prescription or objective datum that hampers the commander’s freedom of action and requires measures to be taken.
Mesure à prendre ou condition à réaliser: Measure to be taken or condition to be met that is essential to the success of the manoeuvre.
Décrit à l’indicatif : aspect positif /: Written in the indicative: positive / negative aspect of one MA compared with another MA, in light of combined-arms criteria and criteria specific to the operational functions.
Action générique caractérisant un type d: Generic action characterising a type of action according to the effects to be produced: offensive, defensive, security, assistance mode.
Façon d’agir dominante issue des modes t: Dominant way of acting derived from the tactical modes, at command levels 1 to 3, used to choose the assets and combine their actions to produce an effect on the enemy or the environment. At subordinate levels, the manoeuvre is executed: a mission is received.
Expression claire et concise de l’action: Clear and concise statement of the action to be carried out and the purpose pursued.
Ce qui doit être accompli pour que la mi: What must be accomplished for the mission to be executed: all (rarely) or part (most often) of the action to be undertaken. It involves the use of specific assets and procedures (movement, crossing, debouching, reception…). Tasks may be simultaneous or successive.
Spécifiée : explicitement notifiée dans: Specified: explicitly stated in the superior’s orders (directive, OPLAN, PS, OPORD, FRAGO). Implied: implicit, deduced from the analysis of the mission received.
Conséquence potentiellement défavorable: Potentially unfavourable / favourable consequence that may result from the confrontation between the friendly and the adversary manoeuvre.
Emploi des forces combinant mouvement, f: Employment of forces combining movement, fires and effects in the non-physical fields to gain a favourable position and accomplish the mission. Three stages: preparation, achievement and exploitation of the decisive effect (they do not always coincide with the phases of the MA).
Expression nette et concise de la façon: Clear and concise statement of how the commander intends to accomplish the mission: how, when and where he wants to act, without detailing the allocation of assets. It covers the whole of the mission.
Succession d’actes combinant attitudes e: Sequence of acts combining postures and assets in space and time to accomplish the tasks. Related to the terrain, general enough to keep their number small, precise enough to be distinguished.
Synthèse de la contribution de notre act: Summary of our action’s contribution to the superior’s manoeuvre; the spirit of the mission (“Why?”). Begins with “With a view to” or “In order to”, oriented towards the higher level.
Résulte de l’action décisive, directe ou: Results from the decisive action, direct or indirect, against an adversary, within a given space-time frame, the exploitation of which makes it possible to accomplish the mission.
Capacité spécifique et localisée (une un: Specific, localised capability (a unit or group of forces) that conditions the system’s freedom of action in its ability to achieve its objectives; the “key capability”. Studying it identifies the enemy vulnerabilities to target and the friendly ones to protect. It must be within reach of our assets. In the French method: a mere tool, unrelated to the decisive effect.
Hypothèse de travail sur un paramètre de: Working hypothesis on a parameter of the study (never on the enemy): necessary, achievable and verified before the action.
Action directe ou indirecte contre l’adv: Direct or indirect action against the adversary, within a given space-time frame, that makes it possible to gain a decisive advantage within the mission: it exploits a significant opportunity or counters a significant risk.
Cadre temporel d’obtention de l’effet ma: Time frame in which the decisive effect is obtained, i.e. the end of the decisive action (not its start). It is not the moment when the force ratio tips.
Lieu de l’action décisive retenue. Ébauc: Location of the selected decisive action. Outlined during the friendly terrain analysis, it becomes final at the confrontation of the enemy and friendly sequences.
But à atteindre accompagné de l’effet ma: Purpose together with the decisive effect: the commander’s contribution to the superior’s manoeuvre and how he intends to accomplish his mission.
Liste chronologique des tâches interarme: Chronological list of the combined-arms tasks a unit must carry out as part of its mission (or MAG). It is not a course of action: it becomes one in phase 2, when the manoeuvres of all functions are related to terrain and timings.
Capacité d’une unité à réaliser des miss: Ability of a unit to carry out successive missions according to the engagement – attrition – regeneration – re-engagement cycle. Must be used when designing courses of action.
Se déclinent en PIR (besoins prioritaire: Broken down into PIR (priority intelligence requirements), FFIR (friendly force information), EEFI (information to be protected) and HNIR (host nation information). PIRs are validated according to the MA selected at the decision briefing.
La définition de l’effet majeur a changé: The definition of the decisive effect changed in 2022: the former one (“condition whose achievement guarantees the success of the mission”) is obsolete.
Effet majeur et centre de gravité ne son: Decisive effect and centre of gravity are not linked in the French method: the centre of gravity is a tool, the decisive effect is at the heart of the reasoning.
Pas de présupposition sur l’ennemi : ses: No assumption about the enemy: its courses of action can only be supposed, never verified before the action.
C’est l’articulation entre but à atteind: It is the link between purpose and decisive effect that enables subsidiarity: the purpose places our action within the commander’s manoeuvre, the decisive effect allows subordinates to place their action within the overall manoeuvre.
Entraîne-toi à la chaîne de raisonnement: Practise the chain of reasoning: for each fact identified in an order or a situation, write the deduction then the tactical conclusion (in the form of T, C, I, D or R).
